caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug placed against a plain, light beige background. The jug is bulbous at the base and narrows towards the neck before widening slightly at the rim. It features a prominent handle attached from the upper neck to the shoulder. The jug is primarily depicted in tones of light brown with subtle shadowing to suggest its roundness and depth. Decorative blue patterns, including curved lines and stylized leaf or feather shapes, are painted on the body and neck of the jug, while parallel blue bands encircle the neck and top rim. The overall lighting creates a soft shadow underneath and to the left of the jug, indicating the illumination comes from the upper right. There are no other objects or elements in the drawing.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
